# CommandCenterFinance

> CommandCenterFinance builds verified, subscription-free spreadsheet templates ("finance command centers") for high-stakes money moments: small business bookkeeping and quarterly taxes, contractor bid comparison, renovation cost control, medical bill reconciliation, and family care coordination. Every template works in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and LibreOffice, ships with a Quick-Start PDF and realistic sample data, and is a one-time purchase (no subscription) sold as an instant digital download on Etsy.

Key facts:

- Shop: https://www.etsy.com/shop/CommandCenterFinance (instant digital downloads; .xlsx + Quick-Start PDF)
- Based in the United States; opened August 2026
- No macros, no add-ins, no locked passwords — formulas are protected against accidental edits but always visible
- Every template is verified before listing: structural audit, full recalculation against hand-derived expected values, error-cell scan, and live mutation tests
- Templates are planning/organization tools, not tax, legal, or medical advice
- Support: free setup help via Etsy Messages

## Products

- [Small Business Finance Command Center](https://www.etsy.com/listing/4548207390/small-business-bookkeeping-spreadsheet): Available now, $19.99 (50% launch sale through Aug 31, 2026). All-in-one bookkeeping spreadsheet for freelancers, Etsy/Amazon sellers, coaches, contractors, and side-hustlers. 8 tabs: auto dashboard, income & expense trackers (900+ rows each), quarterly tax estimator, profit & loss statement, mileage log, start-here guide.
- [ScopeGuard](https://commandcenterfinance.github.io/#scopeguard): Coming soon. Tracks the scope you promised against the work you actually delivered — original fee vs. change requests, estimated vs. actual hours, effective hourly rate vs. target — so freelancers, consultants, and designers can see which flat-fee projects and clients are quietly reducing profit. Pairs with, does not replace, day-to-day expense tracking.
- [Contractor Bid Analyzer](https://commandcenterfinance.github.io/#bid-analyzer): Coming soon. Compares up to four contractor bids against one shared scope checklist and builds each bid's likely real cost (base bid plus missing scope, allowance shortfalls, permits, and cleanup), ranked both by cover-page price and by real cost. A pre-signing decision tool; companion to BuildCost Control.
- [BuildCost Control](https://commandcenterfinance.github.io/#buildcost): Coming soon. Tracks the six things that determine a renovation's true final cost — allowances vs. selections, change orders, pending decisions, invoices checked against approvals, credits owed back, and contingency drawdown — feeding one Cost Forecast that updates as the project moves. For homeowners already under contract.
- [Home Warranty & Punch List Command Center](https://commandcenterfinance.github.io/#home-warranty): Coming soon. One record of every walkthrough item and warranty-period defect — builder responses, repair appointments, homeowner verification, reopened items — with a Warranty Deadline Tracker that shows which coverage windows are closing soon while something is still unresolved under them, and a printable Closeout Summary. For new-construction homeowners, condo/HOA buyers, and renovations under a builder's workmanship warranty.
- [Medical Bill Match](https://commandcenterfinance.github.io/#medical-bill-match): Coming soon. Matches provider bills to insurance EOBs (by claim number, or by provider and date of service) and shows what is actually owed — holding back bills that should not be paid yet with one of five plain-language reasons (no EOB, pending claim, open appeal, likely duplicate, amount mismatch). Tracks deductible and out-of-pocket progress and surfaces unclaimed HSA/FSA reimbursements.
- [Divorce Financial Discovery Organizer](https://commandcenterfinance.github.io/#divorce-discovery): Coming soon. Gathers a divorce or separation's scattered financial picture — real estate, bank accounts (institution, nickname, and last 4 digits only — never full account numbers), retirement accounts, vehicles, business interests, and debts — with the user's own working designation of separate/marital/ask-your-attorney. A Missing Information rollup, a Document Requests tracker with aging and deadline flags, and a printable Attorney Meeting Summary. Organizational only: not legal strategy, not a settlement calculator.
- [Estate Contents & Cleanout Command Center](https://commandcenterfinance.github.io/#estate-contents): Coming soon. Room-by-room estate inventory with family claims, automatic competing-claim detection (it flags conflicts, never ranks or decides who should get an item), sell/donate/dispose tracking, appraisals, expenses, sale proceeds, and a distribution ledger that reconciles proceeds minus costs to the cent.
- [ParentCare Command Center](https://commandcenterfinance.github.io/#parentcare): Coming soon. One shared file for coordinating a parent's care across siblings — tasks, appointments, medications with a refill runway, shared expenses, and documents — with a named primary and backup person per responsibility area, and a Weekly Coverage Review that assembles every open flag into one paragraph ready to paste into a family text thread.

- [Household Continuity Command Center](https://commandcenterfinance.github.io/#household-continuity): Coming soon. One shared file for a household's operating knowledge — bills and autopay, utilities, insurance, home systems, service providers, pets, vehicles, children and dependents, documents, and subscriptions — each with an owner, a backup person, and a last-verified date, rolled into a hand-checkable continuity score with three ready-to-print 24-hour/7-day/30-day handoff sheets. Never stores passwords or account numbers; every "where kept" field records a location, not the secret.

- [Shared Family Property Command Center](https://commandcenterfinance.github.io/#shared-property): Coming soon. One shared record for a co-owned vacation home, cabin, or inherited property — stay log, expenses with a per-expense split basis (equal, by ownership share, or usage-weighted by nights), a reimbursement ledger that reconciles balances to zero, maintenance/repairs/supplies tracking, and a Fairness Dashboard showing six numbers per owner household (usage, cash contributed, unpaid balances, tasks completed, ownership share, work hours) with no verdict, score, or ranking.
